title: Owner labels in the Decision Log name individuals, not roles
section: Sheet Open decisions, column Owner; sheet By owner, column Owner
description: Sixteen open-decision rows and twelve By owner rows give the owner as an individual rather than a role: DL01, DL02, DL03, DL04, DL05, DL06, DL07, DL08, DL09, DL12, DL13, DL14, DL20, DL35 and DL37 carry one or more personal labels. The run forbids person names in any output, so each such label is replaced by the value placeholder of Template and Rules §R9, and the paragraph of the row that states a role or an organisation is kept after it. The role each label holds is not stated in the Decision Log.
evidence: Open decisions column F: DL01 one label; DL02 two labels; DL03 one label plus the architecture team; DL04 one label; DL05 one label; DL06 two labels; DL07 one label; DL08 two labels; DL09 two labels; DL12 two labels; DL13 one label plus TechX and Henka; DL14 two labels plus the product owner; DL20 one role plus one label; DL35 one label; DL37 one label. By owner column A carries the same twelve distinct labels against 31 owner rows.
proposed: Confirm the role that owns each of the fifteen open decisions named here and record the role, not the individual, in the Decision Log and in every document that quotes these rows.

title: The amendment of D-RCV-36 T1 and T2 has no wording in any source
source: Recovery Workbench Decision Log v10; Recovery Workbench Microservice Story Template and Rules v1
section: Decisions taken, row D-RCV-36 (T1, T2); Template and Rules §R8.4 ADR-017
description: The realignment marks D-RCV-36 T1 and T2 amended, and §R8.4 says ADR-017 amends them, but no source states what the amended terms read. T1 as written puts one workflow per case on Temporal from Epic 3, and T2 as written keeps Quartz and Spring Batch for every Epic 1 and Epic 2 job with JOB-05 behind the TimerScheduler port; neither says which service owns the workflow, the task queue or the schedule once the module is split into 19 services.
evidence: Decision Log v10 row D-RCV-36 quotes T1 and T2 in full and names no successor term. Template and Rules §R8.4 lists ADR-017 as amending D-RCV-36 T1 and T2 with no text. Architecture v5 slide 41 gives one task queue per service in namespace rwb-recovery and slide 44 gives Schedules in the owning service; plan DP-10 maps Quartz and JOB-nn to a Temporal Schedule or an event-started workflow.
proposed: Confirm the amended text of T1 and T2: the workflow runs on the task queue of the owning service, and each scheduled job becomes a Temporal Schedule or an event-started workflow in the owning service, with JOB-05 kept behind the TimerScheduler port until Epic 3.

title: The version date in the Decision Log header is earlier than its last decision
section: Sheet Open decisions, row 2; sheet Decisions taken, row D-RCV-36
description: The header of v10 is dated 15 November 2026, and the sheet Decisions taken carries D-RCV-36 dated 16 November 2026. A reader cannot tell from the header whether 15 November 2026 is the issue date of the version or the date the sheet text was last edited.
evidence: Open decisions A2 reads 'SCB Collections and Recovery, Henka Group, 15 November 2026.'; Decisions taken C27 holds 2026-11-16 for D-RCV-36. D-RCV-35 in the same sheet is dated 2026-11-15.
proposed: State which date the header carries: the issue date of the version or the date the sheet text was last edited. The date is kept unchanged in v11 either way.
